paragraphs: Rav Ada bar Rav Aza, Kiddushin 81b; Rav Acha or Rava bar Rav Aza, Temurah 21a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פא :; gives Kiddushin 81b with a trailing semicolon; כא. gives Temurah 21a under the colon/period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
Rav Acha or Rava is an explicit alternative, not an admitted single identity. The separate Rav titles are full; Rava is a whole personal name. Shared patronymics do not establish a single father.
